basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old software developer living in Portland, Oregon. I have a deep love for fantasy novels and spend a lot of my free time reading or playing tabletop RPGs with friends. I'm also an avid gamer, particularly fond of strategy and role-playing games. My work involves developing web applications, and I often work late into the night, which aligns with my typical online hours from 10 PM to 2 AM PST. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom to travel whenever possible, often attending gaming conventions and book festivals. I have a strong interest in women's health and regularly participate in discussions on related subreddits.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over a decade. I am largely self-taught in terms of programming languages outside of my formal education. My interests in gaming and literature stem from a lifelong passion and have been further developed through community engagement and personal research.
